About half of the tickets are gone, and every remaining $1 million prize is still out there — fewer tickets, same big prizes. That's not luck talk, that's arithmetic on a fixed print run. The numbers get re-crunched every morning, and this page moves with them.

995.body: "$200,000 Triple Play" is deep into its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still out there. Games late in their run get interesting when the prizes outlast the tickets; early ones are mostly a bet on the design. Here, the big prizes have outlasted the tickets so far, which is the setup you want to see. All of it comes straight from official North Carolina lottery numbers, current through September 25.
995.headline: Where this game is in its run

996.body: "$1,000,000 Triple Play" keeps doing the most interesting thing a scratcher can do: nothing. The $1 million top prizes haven't been hit since we started watching it, while the everyday prizes keep getting claimed out of an ever-smaller stack of tickets. They printed a fixed number of these — every quiet day tightens that math a little more. Every line of $1,000,000 Triple Play's prize table below is today's tally, not last month's.
